title: Safe harbour from insolvent trading for directors attempting a turnaround
summary: From September 2017 directors pursuing a course of action reasonably likely to lead to a better outcome are protected from personal liability for insolvent trading.

instruments.title: Treasury Laws Amendment (2017 Enterprise Incentives No. 2) Act 2017

direction_rationale: Lower personal risk for directors should encourage turnarounds of viable firms rather than premature liquidation.
comparison: No state or size variation; event study on insolvency series only

verified.notes: ASIC documents give 18, 19 or 22 September 2017; the register commencement has not been checked.

review.notes: Drafted by AI-assisted desk research on 18 October 2026 (legislation gap scan, docs/legislation_gap_scan.md) from the sources cited. Not yet checked by a person: verify dates, industries and the direction hypothesis before use.

assessment.summary: Directors who pursue a reasonable turnaround plan are protected from personal liability for insolvent trading. It can save viable firms from premature liquidation, though evidence on how often it is used is limited.

marks.reason: Lowers the personal risk of trying to restructure a struggling firm, making exit and turnaround decisions better.
